directives.title: Reprice API for revenue density
directives.rationale: $20/day at $0.001-0.005/call needs thousands of calls/day. Reprice to $0.01/$0.02/$0.05 tiers and add a $0.25 premium tier so fewer sales are needed.

directives.title: Launch premium endpoints (analysis/report generation)
directives.rationale: High-ticket items: full-text analysis report, structured data extraction, batch processing. Each sale should earn $0.10+.

directives.title: Get listed where x402 buyers look
directives.rationale: No external buyer has ever called our API. Distribution is the binding constraint.

directives.title: Convert GitHub README into a landing page that sells
directives.rationale: Repo is public; organic traffic should convert. Needs pricing table, live demo curl examples, revenue proof.
